description.value:
Requires Attunement

Ammo DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier

Features

Mastery (Slow)

If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

Magazine

The weapon holds a maximum of 4 loaded rounds at a time. When the magazine reaches 0, you must reload it before you can fire again.

▸ Upgrade — Magazine Upgrade I

Your magazine capacity increases to 6 rounds of standard ammunition (Normal, Pierce, or Spread).

▸ Upgrade — Magazine Upgrade II

Your magazine capacity increases to 8 rounds of standard ammunition.

Reload

Action.

You can fully reload your magazine using an Action or a Bonus Action. When you do so, you choose the type of ammunition the weapon will contain.

Ignition

Whenever you hit a creature with this weapon, you gain 1 Ignition (maximum 3). Ignition remains until you spend it and is not lost when the magazine is empty.

Wyvernheart

Bonus Action.

Spend 1 Ignition to make one additional attack with this weapon as a Bonus Action. If you already hit a creature with this weapon this turn, this extra attack deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] Piercing damage.

▸ Upgrade — Wyvernheart Upgrade I

When you use Wyvernheart after already hitting a creature with this weapon this turn, the extra damage increases to [[/r 1d8]] Piercing.

Guard

Reaction.

When a creature you can see hits you with an attack while you are wielding this weapon, you can use your Reaction to roll [[/r 1d4]] and add it to your AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. You cannot use Guard on the same turn you used Wyvernheart.

▸ Upgrade — Guard Upgrade I

When you use Guard, you roll [[/r 1d6]] instead of 1d4 and add it to your AC against the triggering attack.

Special Ammo

Due to barrel pressure limits, you can load a maximum of 2 Special Ammo rounds into the magazine during a reload. Once these are expended, you must reload to switch back to another ammunition type.

▸ Upgrade — Special Ammo Upgrade I

Your magazine can now hold up to 4 Special Ammo rounds.

Wyverncounter

Reaction.

When you use Guard and the triggering attack misses you, you can spend 1 Ignition to make one attack with this weapon against that creature (no additional action required). This attack consumes 1 loaded round and does not apply a special ammunition effect. If the creature is within 15 feet of you, the attack deals an extra [[/r 1d8]] Piercing damage. You cannot use Wyverncounter on a turn you used Wyvernheart.

Ammunition

Normal Ammo

Deals the weapon's base damage ([[/r 1d10]] Piercing) to a single target.

Pierce Ammo

You fire in a 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Make a single attack roll and compare it against the AC of each creature in that line. All creatures hit take the weapon's normal damage.

Spread Ammo

Instead of making an attack roll, you fire a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Ammo DC. On a failed save, a creature takes [[/r 1d10]] Piercing damage.

Cluster Ammo

This ammo deals no weapon damage. On a hit, it explodes, dealing [[/r 2d6]] Fire damage to the target and each creature within 5 feet of it.

Recover Ammo

Instead of taking damage, a willing creature hit by this ammo regains [[/r 1d4]] hit points.

Poison Ammo

A creature hit by this ammo must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Ammo DC or have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

Paralysis Ammo

A creature hit by this ammo must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Ammo DC or become Incapacitated and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the end of your next turn. If it fails the save by 5 or more, it is Paralyzed instead until the end of your next turn.

Sticky Ammo

A creature hit by this ammo must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Ammo DC or have the Restrained condition for 1 minute. The creature can use its action to attempt to escape (escape DC equal to your Ammo DC).

Slicing Ammo

Instead of making a ranged weapon attack, choose a target within this weapon's long range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Ammo DC, taking [[/r 4d6]] Slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If the target is beyond this weapon's normal range, it has advantage on the save.

Wyvern Ammo

You do not make an attack roll with this ammo. Instead, each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Ammo DC, taking [[/r 2d12]] Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
